Ids are page-scoped and hyphenated per Sean's 2026-08-10 call: [brg_home-hero] style,
which needs no change to the plugin's [a-z0-9-] slug sanitiser.
'stacks' is the per-page shortcode order decoded from the Figma annotation columns;
the plugin doesn't need it, but the harness composes from it and it documents the build.
Slot defaults are REAL production copy, not placeholders — Conti's contract rule, so that
a default compose-test represents the live page.
